jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Office: Extron USA
Location: Anaheim, CA
Department: Purchasing and Planning
# of Openings: 1

JUNIOR DATA ANALYST

Company Overview

Extron is a leading developer and manufacturer of professional AV hardware and software solutions which serve the ever-changing needs of organizations around the world as they strive to better communicate. Each Extron product is carefully engineered to provide best-in-class performance, intuitive operation, and exceptional reliability. At Extron, the passion for our products is evidenced by our company culture, which encourages innovation and provides opportunities for individual career growth. Our teams develop and release over 100 new products a year and continue to grow our vast patent portfolio.

Position Overview

Extron is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have a strong analytical background in statistics, mathematics, data science, or economics and be capable of transforming complex datasets into meaningful insights that support business and technical decision-making. This position offers the opportunity to work with engineering, operations, and management teams to develop data models, automate reporting processes, and improve organizational performance through data analysis.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Collect, organize, validate, and analyze large datasets from multiple sources.
Develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations to support business and operational objectives.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data.
Design and maintain databases, data models, and reporting tools.
Develop and maintain Microsoft Excel and Access-based applications, including VBA macros and automation solutions.
Prepare technical reports and presentations.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity.
Assist with special projects and analytical studies as assigned.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, data science, information systems, business or similar.
2+ years of related experience.
Advanced skills in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, including advanced formulas and data analysis.
Proficiency in Power BI, and Power Automate.
Proficiency in SQL required, experience working within SQL servers and Avante.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

Salary Range: $72,304 to $75,000. Pay may vary depending on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager - BI and Data Science - Merchandising & Store Operations
jobs.description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods
, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

Overview

Overview

We are looking for a Group Product Manager to lead BI and Data Science product management for Merchandising, Planning, Inventory, and Store Operations. This leader will own the product strategy and roadmap for the intelligence products that help DSG teams plan assortments, manage inventory, optimize seasonal decisions, operate stores, and understand performance across the business.

The portfolio includes certified reporting, operational dashboards, planning and merchandising data products consumed through insights experiences, self-service analytics, and applied data science capabilities such as forecasting, optimization, recommendations, and decision support. This leader will partner across Merchandising, Planning, Stores, Supply Chain, Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, Architecture, and business leadership to translate complex operational needs into scalable products that improve speed, quality, and consistency of decision-making.

This is a hands-on product leadership role. The GPM will lead BI product managers, manage third-party PM capacity, establish portfolio discipline, and shape the future team structure as DSG expands its in-house product capability in this space.

Why this role matters

This role sits at the center of how DSG modernizes decision-making across merchandising and store operations. The leader will help move teams from fragmented reports, manual analysis, and reactive planning toward trusted reporting, governed metrics, self-service insights, and model-enabled recommendations that improve planning quality, inventory productivity, store execution, and athlete experience.

This is a rare opportunity to lead a high-impact intelligence portfolio at the intersection of retail operations, merchandising, planning, inventory, and applied AI. The role has direct visibility into how DSG makes some of its most important business decisions and will shape the products, operating model, and team structure that modernize decision-making across stores and merchandising.

Key Responsibilities

Own the portfolio strategy and roadmap for BI, reporting, analytics, decision support, and applied data science across Merchandising, Planning, Inventory, and Store Operations.
Lead store operations intelligence for senior store vice presidents, field leaders, store managers, store captains, and operational teams.
Lead merchandising and planning intelligence for merchants, planners, buyers, inventory optimization teams, and seasonal or pre-season planning workflows.
Partner with the Data Products GPM to connect trusted domain data foundations to BI, analytics, decision-support, and applied data science products.
Define where data science should change decisions by identifying high-value opportunities for forecasting, optimization, recommendations, and model-enabled workflows.
Translate ambiguous business asks into clear product problems, measurable outcomes, user workflows, prioritized roadmaps, and delivery plans.
Modernize the reporting ecosystem by moving teams from fragmented dashboards, manual reconciliation, and one-off reporting toward certified metrics, semantic-layer alignment, self-service analytics, and scalable insights products.
Establish clear portfolio governance including intake, prioritization, roadmap reviews, dependency management, release planning, adoption planning, and post-launch value tracking.
Lead and develop product talent including in-house BI PMs and third-party PM resources, with consistent standards for product thinking, documentation, stakeholder alignment, and delivery accountability.
Measure business impact through outcomes such as decision quality, planning cycle time, forecast accuracy, inventory productivity, store execution, adoption, reduced manual effort, and operational ROI.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in product management, data product management, analytics product management, BI product leadership, data science product management, or related technical product roles.
Experience leading product portfolios in merchandising, retail, stores, supply chain, inventory, planning, marketplace, finance, or operations-heavy environments.
Strong product leadership across BI, analytics, metrics, reporting modernization, semantic layers, data products, and/or applied ML.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity in highly matrixed organizations with senior business and technology stakeholders.
Experience managing product managers, contractors, consultants, third-party PMs, or cross-functional delivery partners.
Technical fluency in data platforms, BI tools, analytics engineering, data governance, experimentation, forecasting, optimization, and ML-enabled decision systems.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between executive business needs, user workflows, data constraints, technical tradeoffs, and delivery roadmaps.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required. Advanced degree in business, computer science, engineering, analytics, data science, or a related discipline preferred.

The range listed reflects the anticipated salary for this role, but we recognize that every candidate brings unique experience and skills. There may be flexibility based on individual qualifications, and we encourage open conversations about compensation throughout the hiring process .

Virtual Requirements

At DICK’S, we thrive on innovation and authenticity. That said, to protect the integrity and security of our hiring process, we ask that candidates do not use AI tools (like ChatGPT or others) during interviews or assessments.

To ensure a smooth and secure experience, please note the following:

Cameras must be on during all virtual interviews.
AI tools are not permitted to be used by the candidate during any part of the interview process.
Offers are contingent upon a satisfactory background check which may include ID verification.

If you have any questions or need accommodations, we’re here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone!

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

Bowhead supports government and commercial customers with technical, analytical, and operational services. The company brings together professionals who help organizations manage information, improve business processes, and address complex mission needs. Bowhead values collaboration, sound judgment, and dependable customer service. This Data Analyst position is based in Dahlgren, Virginia, and supports work involving data warehousing, analysis, system development, training, and customer support.

About The Role

Bowhead is seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to help manage and improve data resources and reporting capabilities. In this role, you will work with customers and team members to understand requirements, develop data structures, validate information, and support the delivery of useful analyses and reports. You will investigate data and system issues, conduct product analysis, and help resolve problems through careful review and clear communication.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working with relational database management systems, data warehousing concepts, SQL, and Cognos tools. This position requires the ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a team. Candidates must currently hold a Secret security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required for a Secret clearance at this location.

Qualifications

A high school diploma is required; a bachelor’s degree is highly desired. Candidates should have at least five years of relevant experience and demonstrate strong analytical skills involving relational databases and data warehousing. Experience using the Cognos Tool Suite to create dashboards and reports, along with the ability to write and analyze SQL queries, is important for success in this position.

Qualified candidates will bring knowledge of mathematical reasoning and the communication skills needed to support customers, gather requirements, and validate results. Strong interpersonal skills, good judgment, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability are essential. Candidates should be able to organize their work, exercise initiative, and contribute in both independent and collaborative settings. Experience with security assessment tools such as Nessus, and with implementing and testing security controls, is also required. Familiarity with analytical tools and evaluation techniques is desirable. Knowledge of government accounting is preferred, with Department of Defense accounting experience especially valued.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain data structures and tables that support analysis, reporting, and customer needs. Validate data for accuracy and consistency, document data definitions and processes, and help identify opportunities to improve data quality. Prepare specifications for online queries and reports, database loads, and data validation activities.

Use SQL and applicable reporting tools to analyze information and produce dashboards, reports, or other analytical outputs. Investigate data, product, and system issues; assess their potential causes; and work with relevant stakeholders to resolve problems. Support data warehousing and system development activities, contribute to training, and provide responsive customer support. Gather and clarify requirements, communicate findings, and maintain documentation that helps users understand and apply the resulting data products.

Benefits

The targeted annual salary range for this position is $80,000 to $90,000, depending on qualifications and experience. Salary information is a general guideline and is not a guarantee of an offer. Bowhead considers factors that may include position scope and responsibilities, relevant experience, education and training, key skills, internal equity, and market and business conditions. Eligible benefits and other employment terms are provided in accordance with applicable company policies.

The role may involve lifting up to 15–25 pounds, standing or walking for extended periods, and periodically twisting, bending, or squatting. Candidates should be prepared to meet these physical demands, with reasonable accommodations considered as applicable.

Equal Opportunity

Bowhead is committed to fair and equal employment opportunity. Employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable laws and are based on job-related qualifications, skills, and business needs. Candidates are encouraged to apply if their experience aligns with the requirements of this role.

This Data Analyst position is based in Dahlgren, Virginia, and supports work involving data warehousing, analysis, system development, training, and customer support.

About The Role

Bowhead is seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to help manage and improve data resources and reporting capabilities. In this role, you will work with customers and team members to understand requirements, develop data structures, validate information, and support the delivery of useful analyses and reports. You will investigate data and system issues, conduct product analysis, and help resolve problems through careful review and clear communication.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working with relational database management systems, data warehousing concepts, SQL, and Cognos tools. This position requires the ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a team. Candidates must currently hold a Secret security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required for a Secret clearance at this location.

Qualifications

A high school diploma is required; a bachelor’s degree is highly desired. Candidates should have at least five years of relevant experience and demonstrate strong analytical skills involving relational databases and data warehousing. Experience using the Cognos Tool Suite to create dashboards and reports, along with the ability to write and analyze SQL queries, is important for success in this position.

Qualified candidates will bring knowledge of mathematical reasoning and the communication skills needed to support customers, gather requirements, and validate results. Strong interpersonal skills, good judgment, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability are essential. Candidates should be able to organize their work, exercise initiative, and contribute in both independent and collaborative settings. Experience with security assessment tools such as Nessus, and with implementing and testing security controls, is also required. Familiarity with analytical tools and evaluation techniques is desirable. Knowledge of government accounting is preferred, with Department of Defense accounting experience especially valued.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain data structures and tables that support analysis, reporting, and customer needs. Validate data for accuracy and consistency, document data definitions and processes, and help identify opportunities to improve data quality. Prepare specifications for online queries and reports, database loads, and data validation activities.

Use SQL and applicable reporting tools to analyze information and produce dashboards, reports, or other analytical outputs. Investigate data, product, and system issues; assess their potential causes; and work with relevant stakeholders to resolve problems. Support data warehousing and system development activities, contribute to training, and provide responsive customer support. Gather and clarify requirements, communicate findings, and maintain documentation that helps users understand and apply the resulting data products.

Benefits

The targeted annual salary range for this position is $80,000 to $90,000, depending on qualifications and experience. Salary information is a general guideline and is not a guarantee of an offer. Bowhead considers factors that may include position scope and responsibilities, relevant experience, education and training, key skills, internal equity, and market and business conditions. Eligible benefits and other employment terms are provided in accordance with applicable company policies.

The role may involve lifting up to 15–25 pounds, standing or walking for extended periods, and periodically twisting, bending, or squatting. Candidates should be prepared to meet these physical demands, with reasonable accommodations considered as applicable.

Equal Opportunity

Bowhead is committed to fair and equal employment opportunity. Employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable laws and are based on job-related qualifications, skills, and business needs. Candidates are encouraged to apply if their experience aligns with the requirements of this role.
